deliveredSummary: Management consistently achieved its 18-20% PBDIT margin target in FY26 (achieving 18.9%) and single-digit revenue growth (4.9%). However, EBITDA margin contracted to 16.0% in Sep 2026, putting pressure on recent guidance.

divergences.story: Management remained confident on margin stability within the 18-20% band.
divergences.numbers: Quarterly EBITDA margin dropped to 16.0% in Sep 2026 from 21.0% in Jun 2026.

bull: FY26 consolidated PBDIT margin of 18.9% met management's long-standing 18-20% target band.
Strong cash conversion with operating cash flow reaching Rs 7,088 crore in Mar 2026.
Revenue growth accelerated to 17.9% YoY in Jun 2026 and 16.9% YoY in Sep 2026.
bear: EBITDA margin fell sharply to 16.0% in Sep 2026 from 21.0% in Jun 2026.
Borrowings increased significantly to Rs 4,596 crore by Sep 2026, raising Debt to Equity to 0.21.
Net profit growth slowed to 6.6% YoY in Sep 2026 compared to 39.6% YoY in Jun 2026.
business: Asian Paints is India's largest home decor company, manufacturing wall paints, waterproofing, textures, wall coverings, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lighting, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows across major brands like Asian Paints and Apco.

threads.note: Guidance consistently held at 18-20%. FY26 closed at 18.9%, while H1 FY27 averaged 18.5%.
Guidance maintained at 8-10% (slight tweak to 8-9% in Nov 2026); latest Q2 FY27 decorative volume came in at 6.4%.
